description.value: Tandoori Flavour is an Indian bistro in Victoria's Royal Oak area serving authentic tandoori dishes, curries, kebabs, and freshly baked naan using traditional recipes and locally sourced ingredients. Part of a growing Vancouver Island chain with additional locations in Sidney, Oak Bay, and Duncan, the restaurant offers both elegant dine-in service and private event hosting. Online ordering is available for cyclists looking to grab a meal without a long wait.
